description: Source code for handling Exhaust Gas Oxygen (EGO) sensors, including support for narrow-band and wide-band sensors, averaging algorithms, and sensor initialization.

methods.name: initEgoAveraging
methods.description: Initializes the EGO averaging system, enabled only for narrow-band sensors.

methods.name: updateEgoAverage
methods.description: Updates the moving average of AFR for narrow-band sensors using CIC filtering.

methods.name: hasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if an AFR sensor is present, considering CJ125 or other configurations.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Retrieves the current AFR value from the sensor, supporting narrow-band and other types.

methods.name: initEgoSensor
methods.description: Initializes sensor parameters based on sensor type.

methods.name: setEgoSensor
methods.description: Sets the sensor type and initializes the sensor accordingly.
